items.source: Convenient implementation of the IntroductionInterceptor interface.
items.translation: 方便实现 IntroductionInterceptor 接口。

items.source: Static utility methods for composing MethodMatchers.
items.translation: 用于组合MethodMatchers的静态实用方法。

items.source: Abstract generic PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice to be configured.
items.translation: 抽象通用PointcutAdvisor，允许配置任何Advice。

items.source: Abstract base class for PointcutAdvisor implementations.
items.translation: PointcutAdvisor 抽象基类实现。

items.source: Static utility methods for composing ClassFilters.
items.translation: 用于组合ClassFilters的静态实用方法。

items.source: Simple IntroductionAdvisor implementation that by default applies to any class.
items.translation: 简单的IntroductionAdvisor实现，默认适用于任何类。

items.source: Support for implementations of IntroductionInfo.
items.translation: 支持IntroductionInfo的实现。

items.source: Convenient class for regexp method pointcuts that hold an Advice, making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于持有 Advice 的 regexp 方法点切面的便捷类，使其成为Advisor。

items.source: Convenient superclass when we want to force subclasses to implement the MethodMatcher interface but subclasses will want to be pointcuts.
items.translation: 当我们需要强制子类实现 MethodMatcher 接口，但子类希望成为切入点时，这是一个方便的父类。

items.source: Pointcut and method matcher for use as a simple cflow-style pointcut.
items.translation: 用于作为简单cflow风格切入点的方法匹配器。

items.source: Regular expression pointcut based on the java.util.regex package.
items.translation: 基于java.util.regex包的正则表达式切入点。

items.source: Convenience classes for using Spring's AOP API.
items.translation: 用于使用 Spring AOP API 的便利类。

items.source: Core Spring AOP interfaces, built on AOP Alliance AOP interoperability interfaces.
items.translation: 核心 Spring AOP 接口，基于 AOP Alliance AOP 互操作性接口构建。

items.source: Annotation support for AOP pointcuts.
items.translation: 支持面向切面编程（AOP）切入点注解。

items.source:
Abstract BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于抽象 BeanFactory 的切点 Advisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用。

items.source:
Abstract superclass for expression pointcuts,
offering location and expression properties.
items.translation: 表达式点切面的抽象超类，提供位置和表达式属性。

items.source: Abstract base regular expression pointcut bean.
items.translation: 抽象基正则表达式点切面 Bean。

items.source: Utility methods for AOP support code.
items.translation: 用于支持 AOP 代码的工具方法。

items.source: Convenient class for building up pointcuts.
items.translation: 用于构建切面的便捷类。

items.source:
Concrete BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in the BeanFactory,
as well as the Pointcut to be configured through a bean property.
items.translation: 基于 Concrete BeanFactory 的 PointcutAdvisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用，同时通过 bean 属性配置 Pointcut。

items.source: Convenient Pointcut-driven Advisor implementation.
items.translation: 方便的基于切面的顾问实现。

items.source:
Convenient abstract superclass for dynamic method matchers,
which do care about arguments at runtime.
items.translation: 用于动态方法匹配器的便捷抽象父类，这些匹配器在运行时确实关心参数。

items.source:
Convenient superclass when we want to force subclasses to
implement MethodMatcher interface, but subclasses
will want to be pointcuts.
items.translation: 当我们需要强制子类实现 MethodMatcher 接口，但子类将作为切点使用时，这是一个方便的父类。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by pointcuts that use String expressions.
items.translation: 由使用字符串表达式的切入点实现的接口。

items.source:
Pointcut bean for simple method name matches, as an alternative to regular
expression patterns.
items.translation: 用于简单方法名匹配的切点 Bean，作为正则表达式模式的替代方案。

items.source:
Convenient class for name-match method pointcuts that hold an Advice,
making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于名称匹配方法切面的便捷类，它持有 Advice 并将其转换为 Advisor。

items.source:
Pointcut constants for matching getters and setters,
and static methods useful for manipulating and evaluating pointcuts.
items.translation: 用于匹配 getter 和 setter 的切点常量，以及用于操作和评估切点的实用静态方法。

items.source: Simple ClassFilter implementation that passes classes (and optionally subclasses).
items.translation: 简单的 ClassFilter 实现，用于传递类（以及可选的子类）。

items.source:
Convenient abstract superclass for static method matchers, which don't care
about arguments at runtime.
items.translation: 适用于静态方法匹配器的便捷抽象父类，这些匹配器不关心运行时的参数。

items.source: Convenient base class for Advisors that are also static pointcuts.
items.translation: 适用于也是静态切面的 Advisor 的便捷基类。
